 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE SANDEEP KUMAR
ORAL ORDER 5 18-07-2023
Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and learned APP for the State.

The present application has been filed for quashing F.I.R vide Parsa Bazar P.S. Case No. 111 of 2019 registered for the offences under Sections 498A and 34 of the Indian Penal Code and Section  of the D.P. Act.
As per F.I.R, the marriage of informant was solemnized with Chandan Kumar on 03.12.2017 thereafter, she went to her matrimonial home and started leading her conjugal life.

It is alleged that after some years, the husband of the Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.16280 of 2021(5)
dt.18-07-2023 informant took her to his place of posting and thereafter informant's husband started demanding Rupees 5 lakhs as informant's husband had lost his job, the informant objected.

The informant's husband started torturing her and also ousted the informant from his house and he told Rubi Soni @ Rubi Kumari @ Rubi Devi vs The State Of Bihar on 18 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/22783201/
1 that he loves someone else and will marry her.

entities.text: Kahkashan Kausar @ Sonam Vs. State of Bihar reported in 2022 SCC OnLine SC 162
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: I have considered the submissions of the parties and also perused the materials available on record including the F.I.R.

It appears that petitioner no. 1 is the mauseri mother-in- law and petitioner no.
2 is the mausera father-in-law of the informant and they are residing in Aurangabad.
There are general and omnibus allegations against them.
Considering the aforesaid facts of this case and also considering the law laid down by the Hon'ble Supreme Court in the case of Kahkashan Kausar Sonam and Ors (supra), this Patna High Court CR.
MISC. No.16280 of 2021(5) dt.18-07-2023 application is allowed.

The F.I.R vide Parsa Bazar P.S.
Case No. 111 of 2019 registered for the offences under Sections 498A and 34 of the Indian Penal Code and Section  of the D.P. Act and all consequential proceedings arising out of aforesaid F.I.R are hereby quashed with respect to petitioners only in the interest of justice.
